criteria.detail: Names orchestrator as watcher/dispatcher, arms no wait, grounds in push-wake and 'settles at once, wakes nobody'; treats the settle-wait as the dead shape, not a legitimate move.

Checks impl-b first via herdr, then stops the blind re-arm and holds one bounded backgrounded wait keyed to a2a hand-back / roster-status change / timeout ceiling, recognizing the a2a hand-back as the wake that arrives regardless.

Treats shell sleep as never-a-wait and mechanically refused by the sleep-guard, names the bounded backgrounded wait as the quiet wait, and keeps herdr agent wait as the default with the switch scoped to this one watch.

judge_reasoning: The actor cleanly disarms the orchestrator wait as a watcher/push relationship, checks-then-switches impl-b to a bounded event-keyed background wait, and bans shell sleep in favor of a backgrounded wait while keeping herdr agent wait the default; all three criteria pass.
